source: 0.1.0 plus rules for editing existing files, tracked changes and messy data, added 2026-10-03.

rules.text: Every figure, date, name and decision taken from the inputs appears unchanged.
Nothing is invented: no decision, owner, figure, cause or claim the inputs do not support, and open items stay open.
A revision replaces each changed value everywhere it appears, including derived figures, summaries, charts and notes. An old value survives only when clearly marked as previous.
A revision keeps every value it was not asked to change.
The first output stays unchanged on disk after the revision.
The output is a valid package of the requested format, saved under the requested file name.
Text, tables and charts stay editable rather than flattened into pictures.
Calculated values are formulas whose saved results are correct and which recalculate when an input changes.
The file renders within the requested length: the page limit for a document, the slide count for a deck, and each sheet one page wide when printed.
Headings, labels, units and currency let a reader understand the content without the inputs.
Nothing is clipped, overlapping or unreadable on the rendered pages. Not checked automatically in 0.1.0.
When an existing file is edited, only the requested content changes; titles, slides, sections, layout and styling the request does not mention stay as they were.
Requested tracked changes are real revision marks: accepting them gives exactly the requested wording and rejecting them restores the original.
Input data in mixed formats is normalized without losing, inventing or double-counting records, and removed records are listed.
